groupText: Our headquarters are located at the Institute of Informatics of the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul. We maintain an ongoing partnership with the Hospital de Clínicas de Porto Alegre, and our research is interdisciplinary, involving students from computer science and health sciences, with the goal of studying techniques to improve healthcare.
groupTitleContext: — Takere Research Lab, a digital health research group
linesIntro: Our focus is on finding solutions that improve patient adherence to and monitoring of treatment through technology.
